text:
arjun_fin: Heads-up team 1 APAC vendor WaveTransit sent a retroactive bill WT-302 for $63,420.75 for NovJan peering/eigr tariff adjustments. They labeled it "rate correction applied to prior consumption". Need guidance for month-end: is this a COGS true-up, contra-revenue, or a deferral reversal? tagging @ellie_rev @olivia_fp&a

ellie_rev: Need to know whether we passed those egress costs to customers. Also whether customer invoices included an explicit "network egress" pass-through line or if we absorbed historically. Any mapping to revenue schedules?

maya_billing: Uploaded PDF and our preliminary match: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/WT-302-pkg.pdf. Our billing extract shows explicit egress lines on ~20 customer invoices across NovJan. Roughing estimate: $41k pass-through, $22k absorbed.

olivia_fp&a: Materiality check: quarterly materiality threshold = $30k. Total vendor bill $63k > threshold so disclosure risk. If $41k maps to billed customers we likely need revenue adjustments for prior periods (not just expense).

support-ops: Ops note: customers that will get supplemental invoices should receive a heads-up; I'll prepare a short CS template explaining retro true-ups and what to expect re: credits or invoices.

maya_billing: I created a CSV with per-customer lines and rev_schedule_id and uploaded here: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/WT-302-breakout.csv. Columns: customer_id, cust_invoice_no, vendor_line_ref, amt, rev_schedule_id, contract_allows_rebilling (yes/no). About 6 customers marked no.

ellie_rev: Good. For customers with contract_allows_rebilling=yes -> issue supplemental invoices and adjust revenue schedules. For the 6 flagged no -> accrue revenue until we can invoice or absorb. We should prepare JE templates for both flows.

olivia_fp&a: Draft JE options:
Option 1 (issue supplemental invoices where allowed):
Date: 2026-03-31
Dr 4110 Accounts Receivable                      $41,000.00
Cr 4000 Revenue - Usage Pass-through             $41,000.00
Dr 6000 COGS - Network                           $63,420.75
Cr 2002 Accrued-Vendor                           $63,420.75
Notes: allocate revenue to rev schedules per CSV; cash collection subject to customer acceptance.

Option 2 (accrue where cannot invoice):
Date: 2026-03-31
Dr 2002 Accrued-Revenue                          $22,420.75
Cr 4000 Revenue - Usage Pass-through             $22,420.75
Dr 6000 COGS - Network                           $63,420.75
Cr 2002 Accrued-Vendor                           $63,420.75
Notes: for the 6 customers we will hold accrual until billing/legal path decided.

maya_billing: One nuance: a subset of the pass-through customers were on a fixed monthly bundle billed in arrears; their invoices already included an immaterial egress estimate. We need to map those to rev schedules carefully so we don't double count. I've flagged those rows in the CSV with "estimation_flag".

ellie_rev: Also check ASC 606 reversal rules and whether this triggers a prior period restatement vs prior period adjustment. Given materiality, we will treat as prior-period adjustment with disclosure in the close pack. Audit needs to be looped in.

olivia_fp&a: I'll draft disclosure language for the month-end close: brief description, amount by type (supplemental invoices vs accrual), impact on revenue and gross margin, and note auditors contacted.

billing-bot: WT-302 entered in AP workflow. Suggested staging GL 2002-Accrued-Vendor. VendorRef: WT-302-2026-01.

maya_billing: Practical ask: need sign-off on which customers to invoice vs accrue. Proposed split based on contract_allows_rebilling + legal check. I can route a final CSV to @ellie_rev for sign-off by 5pm PT.

ellie_rev: Please route. Also include per-row recommended JE (issue invoice vs accrue) and a "materiality_flag" where amt>10000. Any single customer >$10k requires FP&A lead sign-off.

support-ops: I'll prepare the CS FAQ and a short incident note for the console so SRE/support can field billing questions without escalating.

olm: quick thumbs up messages and a 4pm sync invite

maya_billing: CSV uploaded and invite sent. Final action items recap: 1) maya_billing -> final CSV with invoice/accure decision + materiality flag by 17:00 PT. 2) olivia_fp&a -> prepare JE templates and disclosure language. 3) ellie_rev -> review and sign off JE and audit notification. 4) support-ops -> customer communication script.

ellie_rev: I'll review the CSV and loop audit if needed. Thanks all.
